summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for Email Templates redesign. Core template APIs, migration behavior, renderer branding safety, and admin UI edit/persist/restore flow passed in initial runs. One pre-existing related regression test failed due outdated disposable-email fixture data, and later reruns hit public endpoint timeouts (infrastructure/network instability).

critical.issue: Intermittent public endpoint timeout observed after initial successful runs (curl /api and pytest HTTP requests timed out with no response).

minor.issue: Existing test_customer_email_notifications.py uses aliko@yopmail.com, now blocked by disposable-domain policy; test fails with 400 before welcome-email assertion.

action_items: Update TestPortalRegisterWelcomeEmail fixture to non-disposable domain (and satisfy purchaser precondition if needed) so related regression suite remains green.
Investigate preview ingress/public endpoint stability (timeouts on /api after earlier green runs) before relying on repeated HTTP regression runs.
Review whether legacy _customer_email_html (hardcoded PCAdmin banner) should be migrated to the branded modern renderer for manual customer-message emails too.
critical_code_review_comments: Email-template API contract is implemented correctly for this story: seven template IDs, per-template PATCH, brand PATCH, validation for accent/logo, and default+legacy merge migration.
Transactional flows under send_customer_* and verification renderer use _render_saved_template/_render_email_template with brand_name placeholder substitution and HTML escaping.
A legacy helper (_customer_email_html) still contains hardcoded 'PCAdmin' styling; if this helper is intended to stay user-facing, it is inconsistent with the new branded modern layout direction.

success_rate.backend: Core functional checks passed (44/45 before timeout event); subsequent rerun attempts were blocked by public endpoint timeouts
success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested Email Templates UI flow (load, tabs, preview toggle, save persistence, restore)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Temporary UI template subject mutation was restored to original value in the same run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Templates feature checks were green in initial run windows and UI mutation was restored. If rerunning broad suites, expect one welcome-email fixture failure until disposable-domain test data is updated. Also verify preview public URL responsiveness first due observed timeout instability.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: test_customer_email_notifications::TestPortalRegisterWelcomeEmail uses yopmail.com, now intentionally blocked by disposable-domain validation; this is a regression-test data mismatch. RCA-2: public preview ingress showed intermittent no-response timeouts on /api endpoints after earlier successful executions, indicating environment/network instability rather than deterministic template business-logic failure.
